complaint_text: My debit card was charged twice for the same hotel booking and the duplicate payment still appears on my account.
I cannot access my online account because my password reset email never arrives, and I am locked out.
A transfer from my checking account was sent to the wrong person and I need the funds returned immediately.
My loan payment was incorrectly applied and now my account shows a missed due date despite my payment being made.
The app shows I am locked out of the service and I cannot use my benefits verification page.
I was refused a mortgage because the lender treated me differently after hearing about my disability.
I suspect there is a scam text asking me to transfer funds to a fake account before my payment is processed.
My family account was closed and I was told a suspicious charge was made without my consent.
My direct deposit was delayed and my employer says there was a mismatch in my account details.
I keep getting an error when trying to sign in to my health portal and I cannot access my records.
A retailer denied my refund because I was treated differently after I reported a discrimination issue in the branch.
The transaction history shows a charge for a service I never used and the merchant claims it was a valid payment.
